nodes.name: HTTP
nodes.description: Defines requests and responses between a client and a server without encryption.

nodes.name: TLS
nodes.description: Transport Layer Security used in web communication for encryption.

nodes.name: HTTPS
nodes.description: Secure version of HTTP built on top of TLS.

nodes.name: HTTP Request
nodes.description: Contains a method, target, headers, and sometimes a body.

nodes.name: HTTP Response
nodes.description: Contains a status code, headers, and optionally a body.

nodes.name: Certificate
nodes.description: Helps the client authenticate the server during the handshake.

nodes.name: DNS
nodes.description: Resolves domain names to records such as IP addresses.

nodes.name: DNS Lookup
nodes.description: Locates a server but does not prove application health.

nodes.name: DNS Caching
nodes.description: Reuses name resolution results until time to live expires.

nodes.name: HTTP Caching
nodes.description: Reuses application responses at a different layer than DNS caching.

nodes.name: Cache-Control
nodes.description: Can specify private responses or prohibit storage with no-store.

nodes.name: ETag
nodes.description: A validator that can support conditional requests and avoid downloading an unchanged representation.

nodes.name: Conditional Requests
nodes.description: Requests supported by validators like ETag to avoid downloading unchanged representations.

nodes.name: Shared Cache
nodes.description: A cache type that must not assume it may safely store a personalized response.

nodes.name: Database Index
nodes.description: Accelerates locating rows without storing an HTTP response.

nodes.name: HTTP 401
nodes.description: Indicates authentication is required or credentials are not accepted.

nodes.name: HTTP 403
nodes.description: Indicates the request is forbidden even when identity is known.

nodes.name: HTTP 429
nodes.description: Indicates too many requests and can include a Retry-After header.

nodes.name: HTTP 503
nodes.description: Indicates that a service is temporarily unavailable.

nodes.name: Authentication
nodes.description: Process required or checked by HTTP 401 responses.

nodes.name: Status Codes
nodes.description: Codes indicating response status such as 401, 403, 429, and 503.

nodes.name: Authentication
nodes.description: Establishes the identity of a caller using credentials or an existing session.

nodes.name: Authorization
nodes.description: Decides whether an established identity may perform a specific action on a resource.

nodes.name: Document Access Control
nodes.description: Control mechanism for restricting access to specific PDFs in an application.

nodes.name: Vector Searches
nodes.description: Protected with the same document scope used for PDF previews.

nodes.name: Graph Traversals
nodes.description: Protected with the same document scope used for PDF previews.

nodes.name: HTTPS
nodes.description: Protects transport, but cannot replace resource permission checks.

nodes.name: Signed Session Cookie
nodes.description: A cookie that lets a server detect tampering and verify an expiry time using a signature.

nodes.name: HttpOnly
nodes.description: A flag that prevents page JavaScript from reading the cookie.

nodes.name: Secure
nodes.description: A flag that restricts cookie transmission to HTTPS.

nodes.name: Signature
nodes.description: Provides integrity for the session cookie rather than secrecy.

nodes.name: Stateless Signed Cookie
nodes.description: Does not by itself create per-user document ownership or provide instant revocation.

nodes.name: Phishing
nodes.description: Uses deceptive messages or websites to persuade disclosure of credentials or unsafe actions.

nodes.name: Deceptive Messages
nodes.description: Messages that may manufacture urgency to discourage checking the sender.

nodes.name: Credential Disclosure
nodes.description: The unauthorized disclosure of user credentials caused by deceptive attacks.

nodes.name: Transport Protection
nodes.description: Encryption of traffic, distinguished from human deception.

nodes.name: Rate Limits
nodes.description: Bound the number of requests a caller may make in a time window.

nodes.name: Expensive AI Operations
nodes.description: Operations that can have a smaller budget than read-only metadata requests.

nodes.name: HTTP 429
nodes.description: Status code that can tell a client to slow down.

nodes.name: Shared Reviewer Code
nodes.description: Maps all reviewers to one shared request budget and shared workspace.

nodes.name: Database Transaction
nodes.description: Groups related changes into a unit that commits or rolls back.

nodes.name: Idempotency
nodes.description: Property where an operation can be applied multiple times without changing the result beyond the initial application.

nodes.name: Safe Retries
nodes.description: Retrying operations safely without unintended side effects.

nodes.name: Deterministic Chunk Identifiers
nodes.description: Identifiers used to prevent repeated ingestion attempts from creating duplicate vectors.

nodes.name: Upserts
nodes.description: Operations that can prevent a repeated ingestion attempt from creating duplicate vectors.

nodes.name: Transactions
nodes.description: A prerequisite for studying idempotency in this workflow.

nodes.name: Deterministic Identifiers
nodes.description: Identifiers that ensure repeated attempts remain safe when an earlier write may have already succeeded.

nodes.name: Compensating Cleanup
nodes.description: Removes partial derived artifacts after a workflow fails across services.

nodes.name: Partial Derived Artifacts
nodes.description: Artifacts left behind after a workflow failure across services.

nodes.name: Workflow Failure
nodes.description: Failure of a workflow across services.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL Rollback
nodes.description: A database rollback that cannot erase points already written to Qdrant.

nodes.name: Idempotent Operations
nodes.description: Operations that can be applied multiple times without changing the result beyond the initial application.

nodes.name: Vector Search
nodes.description: Compares numeric embeddings to locate passages with similar meaning.

nodes.name: Numeric Embeddings
nodes.description: Used in vector search to represent passages and compare meaning.

nodes.name: Similarity Score
nodes.description: Score that measures similarity but does not prove a passage supports the answer.

nodes.name: Reranking
nodes.description: Compares the question and each candidate more carefully.

nodes.name: Evidence Threshold
nodes.description: Can reject weak matches.

nodes.name: Concept Graph
nodes.description: Stores explicit typed relationships such as prerequisites.

nodes.name: Readiness
nodes.description: Decides whether a service can accept useful traffic.

nodes.name: Required Dependencies
nodes.description: Dependencies such as the authoritative database that must work.

nodes.name: Rate-Limit Failures
nodes.description: Failures requiring different operator responses compared to readiness.
